definitions.explanation: Participation in a crime together with another person. Can refer to the act of being complicit or to the person who is an accomplice.

examples.japanese: {共犯|きょうはん}{者|しゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{共犯|きょうはん}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧にあった。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共犯|きょうはん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}→起訴：10577_kiso⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was charged as an accomplice in the case.

notes:
Used in legal and criminal contexts. Can function as both the abstract concept (complicity) and to describe the person ({共犯|きょうはん}{者|しゃ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共犯|きょうはん}{者|しゃ} (accomplice)
- {共犯|きょうはん}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (relationship as accomplices)
- {共犯|きょうはん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as an accomplice)

LEGAL USAGE:
In Japanese criminal law, {共犯|きょうはん} is a technical term covering various forms of joint criminal liability, including ⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧⟦{正犯|せいはん}→正犯：23640_seihan⟧ (co-principal), {教唆犯|きょうさはん} (instigator), and {幇助犯|ほうじょはん} (aiding and abetting).
